title: clinical data manager
note: example row - data management is not a clinical role. REJECT needs no title_group; it only unassigns the value.

title: doctoral researcher
note: 42,231 records. Won 'student' over 'researcher_early' by 0.018 and student supports no role, so every one of them was dropped. A doctoral researcher is a researcher.

title: research intern
note: 28,124 records. Won 'trainee_clinical' by 0.018, which routed research interns into HCP. A research internship is not a clinical traineeship.

title: research group leader
note: 10,200 records. Won 'support_technical' by 0.012 and support_technical supports no role. Runner-up was researcher_early; established is the better fit for someone leading a group.

title: biostatistician
note: 7,723 records. Won 'support_technical' by 0.002 and support_technical supports no role. Biostatistics is research.

title: chair professor
note: 6,338 records, margin 0.000 - a true tie. Won 'leadership', which put it in faculty_head and hcp_administrator. In Hong Kong and much of Asia a Chair Professor is a senior professorship, not a head of department.

title: visiting phd student
note: 5,906 records. Won 'teaching_academic' by 0.001, which labelled visiting doctoral students as lecturers. They are students; student supports no role and that is the correct outcome.

title: visiting researcher
note: 67,191 records, the largest single item in the queue. Was teaching_academic, so it fed lecturer; it matched the anchor 'visiting professor'. A visiting researcher researches - the word is in the title.

title: member
note: 23,157 records. Was teaching_academic via the anchor 'faculty member', matching one word out of two. 'Member' alone carries no occupational information at all, so it is rejected rather than reassigned.

title: research associate professor
note: 12,374 records. Was teaching_academic. In US usage this is a non-tenure research-track faculty title, and 'research professor' with 48,609 records is already researcher_established - so this is consistency as well as meaning.

title: undergraduate researcher
note: 6,342 records. Was researcher_early, feeding researcher and hcp_researcher. An undergraduate is not employed as a researcher anywhere, and 'student researcher' with 5,988 records is already student - so this is consistency as well as meaning.

title: guest scientist
note: 5,877 records. Was teaching_academic via 'visiting professor'. A guest scientist is a researcher.

title: editorial board member
note: 5,535 records. Was teaching_academic via 'faculty member', again on the word 'member'. Serving on an editorial board is not employment as teaching staff and is not an occupation.

title: mr
note: 3,399 records at similarity 0.656, the weakest thing teaching_academic accepted. An honorific, matched against professor and lecturer. Same class as 'dr' - but lecturer is title_required, so unlike hcp there is no second axis to contain it and these go straight into the role.

title: reviewer
note: 3,544 records. Matched the anchor 'reader', a UK academic rank, on word similarity alone. Peer review is not employment.

title: associate editor
note: 7,226 records. Matched 'associate professor' on the word associate. An associate editor is not teaching staff - same decision as 'editorial board member'.

title: associate member
note: 4,714 records. Matched 'associate professor'. Member of what? No occupation - same decision as 'member'.

title: assistant member
note: 2,832 records. Matched 'assistant professor'. Same as 'associate member'.

title: facultativo especialista de área
note: 2,319 records. Spanish for a SPECIALIST PHYSICIAN, the hospital consultant grade - and it was in lecturer, matched on docente and faculty member because facultativo looks like faculty. A clinician labelled as teaching staff.

title: teaching fellow
note: 12,860 records. Was researcher_early, matched 'research fellow' and 'postdoctoral fellow' - the word fellow dominated and teaching was ignored. A teaching fellow teaches.

title: postgraduate
note: 7,542 records. Was researcher_early, matched 'postdoc' and 'postdoctoral researcher' on the shared post prefix. A postgraduate is a graduate student, not a postdoc - a difference of several years and an employment contract.

title: staff
note: 6,806 records. Was researcher_established, matched 'staff scientist' on one word out of two - the same failure as 'member' against 'faculty member'. 'Staff' carries no occupation.

title: senior software engineer
note: 4,826 records. Was researcher_established, matched 'senior scientist' because senior dominated. A software engineer is not a researcher.

title: research grant
note: 3,662 records. Was researcher_early. A grant is a thing, not a person's role.

title: technical director
note: 2,432 records. Was researcher_established, matched 'scientific director' because director dominated. Not research; it is management.

title: clinical director
note: 2,068 records. Was researcher_established, matched 'scientific director' and 'head of laboratory'. A clinical director runs a clinical unit - leadership, which feeds faculty_head and hcp_administrator.

title: dr öğr üyesi
note: 4,246 records. Turkish for Doctor Faculty Member, the assistant professor grade. The unabbreviated form 'dr öğretim üyesi' is already teaching_academic; the abbreviation went to researcher_early via 'wissenschaftlicher mitarbeiter'. Same title, same group.
